name: Ero Cure Kuro
source:
Nagisa's daily life is hard. The turbulent youth days are full of sex encounters both as a normal student and as an ally of justice.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
渚的日子过得颇不轻松。无论是作为普通学生，还是作为正义伙伴，她动荡的青春岁月里都少不了接连而来的性遭遇。
